headline: Anthropic launches Claude Fable and Mythos 5.2 models
summary: Anthropic announced two new models, Claude Fable 5.2 and Claude Mythos 5.2, claiming improvements in coding, reasoning and vision, and faster output than the 5.1 versions.

claims.statement: Anthropic announced two new models, Claude Fable 5.2 and Claude Mythos 5.2, designed to take on technical challenges.

sources.quote: Anthropic is announcing two new models today: Claude Fable 5.2 and Claude Mythos 5.2, which it says are designed to take on "daunting" technical challenges.

claims.statement: Anthropic says the new models show improvements in coding, reasoning and vision, and communicate more clearly with users.

sources.quote: The company claims the new models show improvements in coding, reasoning, and vision, and can generate outputs faster than the 5.1 versions of the Fable and Mythos models.
Anthropic says the new models "show improvements in areas like coding, reasoning, and vision," as well as in communicating more clearly with users.

claims.statement: TechCrunch reported the release comes amid RSI (recursive self-improvement) concerns.

sources.quote: Anthropic releases new Mythos and Fable models amid RSI concerns
